faqs.question: Varo 和传统 npm 组件库有什么不同？
faqs.answer: Varo 的主要交付物是可复制、修改并归业务项目所有的组件与 Blocks 源码，而不是只能从外部覆盖样式的黑盒 UI 包。

faqs.question: Varo 当前支持哪些运行时？
faqs.answer: Registry 的目标标识为 h5 与 weapp；小程序组件接入 weapp-vite。两端都维护 56 个 runtime 组件族，小程序 Registry 当前开放 45 个高共识组件族。

en.name: Varo
en.tagline: Production foundation for cross-runtime component systems
en.description: Registry-first primitives, UI wrappers, theme tokens, business blocks, and Agent UI for H5 and weapp-vite mini-programs, delivered as editable source through the CLI.
en.audience: Vue 3 teams that need shared interaction semantics, component source, and business blocks across H5 and mini-program products.
useCases: Install editable H5 or mini-program component source from the registry
Reuse dual-target business blocks and Agent UI
Build an internal design system from primitives and theme tokens

faqs.question: How is Varo different from a traditional npm UI library?
faqs.answer: Varo primarily delivers component and block source that teams can copy, modify, and own instead of a black-box UI package that is customized only from the outside.

faqs.question: Which runtimes does Varo support today?
faqs.answer: The registry targets are h5 and weapp, with mini-program components integrating with weapp-vite. Both runtimes maintain 56 component families, while the mini-program registry currently exposes 45 high-consensus families.
